sloka: रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिः शतघ्नीभिश्च सर्वतः ।वध्यमानो महाकायो न प्राबुध्यत राक्षसः ।। ६.६०.५५ ।।।।
transliteration: rajjubandhanabaddhābhiḥ śataghnībhiśca sarvataḥ ।vadhyamāno mahākāyo na prābudhyata rākṣasaḥ ।। 6.60.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Tormented by hunger and hit by mountain peaks and huge trees he sprang up suddenly descended and awakened.
